laws.subtitle: Utah Code §Criminal Code — Stalking prohibition
laws.fullDescription: Utah prohibits stalking — repeated non-consensual contact causing substantial distress. Stalking prohibited; cyberstalking covered.
laws.penalty: First-degree stalking: felony. Second-degree: misdemeanor.
laws.exceptions: Lawful investigations by law enforcement are not considered stalking.

quiz.q: Is cyberstalking (electronic harassment) covered by Utah's stalking law?

laws.title: Consumer Data Privacy Law
laws.subtitle: Utah Code §Privacy Act — Breach notification law
laws.fullDescription: Utah: Data breach notification required.
laws.penalty: Data breach notification: civil fines.
laws.exceptions: Small businesses may have reduced obligations under some state laws.

quiz.q: Does Utah have a comprehensive consumer data privacy law?
quiz.explanation: Utah: Breach notification rules only.

laws.title: Social Media Age Verification
laws.subtitle: Utah Code §N/A — No state law

quiz.q: Does Utah require age verification for social media?

laws.title: Environmental Regulations
laws.subtitle: Utah Code §Environmental Code — Environmental protection
laws.fullDescription: Utah: State env agency enforces air, water, waste rules.
laws.penalty: Environmental violations: civil fines up to $25000/day; criminal penalties for willful violations.
laws.exceptions: Some agricultural and industrial uses have specific permitting pathways.

quiz.q: Which agency enforces environmental laws in Utah?

laws.fullDescription: Utah: Renewable Portfolio Standard in effect.

laws.title: Animal Cruelty Laws
laws.subtitle: Utah Code §Criminal Code — Animal cruelty prohibition
laws.fullDescription: Utah prohibits cruelty to animals including torture, beating, neglect, and fighting. Animal cruelty is a felony; neglect is a misdemeanor.
laws.penalty: Intentional cruelty: felony (up to 5 years). Neglect: misdemeanor.
laws.exceptions: Lawful hunting, fishing, pest control, and veterinary procedures are exempt.

quiz.q: What is the maximum penalty for intentional animal cruelty in Utah?

laws.title: Exotic Pet Ownership
laws.subtitle: Utah Code §Wildlife Code — Exotic and wild animal ownership
laws.fullDescription: Utah: Dangerous exotic animals generally prohibited as pets.
laws.penalty: Unlawful possession of prohibited animal: misdemeanor or felony; animal seizure..

quiz.q: Are large exotic cats (lions, tigers) legal as pets in Utah?

laws.fullDescription: Utah: Consumer fireworks regulated.

laws.title: Gambling Laws

laws.fullDescription: Utah: Utah is one of only two states (along with Hawaii) that prohibit virtually all gambling. No casinos, no lottery, no sports betting.
laws.penalty: Illegal gambling: Illegal gambling: misdemeanor..

laws.title: LGBTQ+ Employment Protections
laws.subtitle: Utah Code §Civil Rights Code — Sexual orientation and gender identity protections
laws.fullDescription: Utah: Utah's 2015 SB 296 added sexual orientation and gender identity to housing and employment discrimination laws while carving out religious exemptions.

laws.exceptions: The federal Bostock v. Clayton County (2020) ruling extended Title VII to cover LGBTQ+ workers nationwide.
